Campaign performance metrics (e.g., impressions, clicks, conversions).
Revenue generated by each marketing channel or campaign.
Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) data.
Competitor marketing strategies and benchmarks.
Consumer engagement metrics, such as website traffic, social media interactions, and email open rates.
Sales data correlated with marketing efforts by region and product.

formulas.source: CAC = Total Marketing Spend / Number of New Customers Acquired.

title: Route-to-Market and Distribution Channel Effectiveness Analysis
sourcePath: data/analysis-library/wine-spirits/44 - Route-to-Market and Distribution Channel Effectiveness.md
goal: To evaluate the effectiveness of distribution channels and routes-to-market for wine, beer, and spirits, identifying inefficiencies, opportunities to enhance market reach, and strategies to optimize revenue and profitability.

Performance metrics for distributors, including volume, reliability, and market coverage.
Regional market demand data and consumer preferences.
Competitor distribution strategies and benchmarks.
Inventory turnover rates and channel-specific stock levels.
Consumer feedback and satisfaction with channel availability.

formulas.source: Cost-to-Revenue Ratio = (Channel Costs / Channel Revenue) x 100.

Seasonal or event-driven packaging trends and sales impact.

title: Customer Loyalty and Retention Metrics Analysis
sourcePath: data/analysis-library/wine-spirits/46 - Customer Loyalty and Retention Metrics Analysis.md
goal: To measure customer loyalty and retention for wine, beer, and spirits brands, identify factors driving repeat purchases, and develop strategies to enhance customer lifetime value and reduce churn.
dataRequired: Purchase frequency and repeat purchase rates for each customer segment.
Customer lifetime value (CLV) metrics.
Churn rate data:
`Churn Rate = (Number of Customers Lost in a Period / Total Customers at the Start of the Period) x 100.`
Customer feedback on satisfaction and brand loyalty.
Loyalty program enrollment and engagement data.
Sales data segmented by channel (e.g., DTC, retail, on-premise).
Competitor benchmarks for customer retention metrics.

formulas.source: CLV = (Average Purchase Value x Purchase Frequency) x Average
formulas.step: Calculate Key Retention Metrics ○ Measure repeat purchase rates

Benchmarking data on industry sustainability standards and competitor initiatives.
Consumer perceptions and feedback on sustainability practices.
Costs associated with implementing and maintaining sustainability programs.

formulas.source: Water Efficiency = Total Water Used / Units Produced.
